Fig1->Fig2: middle row (left,centre,right) shifts one step right; top/bottom fixed.
Fig2->Fig3: middle column (top,centre,bottom) shifts one step down; left/right fixed.
Fig3->Fig4: middle row shifts right again (9 X sq -> sq 9 X).
Fig4->Fig5: column D,9,Z shifts down -> Z,D,9; row keeps sq left, X right.
A has X left/9 right with sq centre (wrong); B has 9 centre (column not shifted); C has sq on right; D matches.
